package types

import (
	"crypto"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

// Dumps cross-implementation assembly vectors for the JS SDK (not part of bft-go-base).
func Test_ZZ_DumpJSVectors(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("JS_VECTORS_DIR")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("JS_VECTORS_DIR not set")
	}
	type shardOut struct {
		Shard string `json:"shard"`
		UC    string `json:"uc"`
	}
	type vecOut struct {
		Partition     uint32     `json:"partitionId"`
		View          string     `json:"view"`
		EnclosingUC   string     `json:"enclosingUc"`
		Shards        []shardOut `json:"shards"`
		TreeRoot      string     `json:"shardTreeRoot"`
		ConfHashes    map[string]string `json:"shardConfigurationHashes"`
		NetworkID     uint32     `json:"networkId"`
		Epoch         uint64     `json:"epoch"`
		EpochStart    uint64     `json:"epochStartRound"`
		NodeID        string     `json:"nodeId"`
		SigKey        string     `json:"sigKey"`
	}
	for name, bits := range map[string]int{"shards-1": 0, "shards-4": 2, "shards-8": 3, "shards-4-initial": 2} {
		scheme := pvScheme(bits)
		topo := pvTopology(scheme)
		view := pvView(t, scheme)
		if name == "shards-4-initial" {
			// leaf 1 is a shard in its initial state: native IR with null hash and summary value
			view.Leaves[1].InputRecord = &InputRecord{Version: 1}
		}
		f := pvEnclose(t, view, topo)
		ucs, err := view.AssembleCertificates(f.uc, pvTestPartition, topo, TrustBaseSealVerifier(f.tb), crypto.SHA256)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		vb, err := view.MarshalCBOR()
		require.NoError(t, err)
		eb, err := f.uc.MarshalCBOR()
		require.NoError(t, err)
		nodes := f.tb.GetRootNodes()
		require.Len(t, nodes, 1)
		o := vecOut{Partition: uint32(pvTestPartition), View: hex.EncodeToString(vb), EnclosingUC: hex.EncodeToString(eb),
			TreeRoot: hex.EncodeToString(f.tree.RootHash()), ConfHashes: map[string]string{},
			NetworkID: uint32(f.tb.GetNetworkID()), Epoch: f.tb.GetEpoch(), EpochStart: f.tb.GetEpochStart(),
			NodeID: nodes[0].NodeID, SigKey: hex.EncodeToString(nodes[0].SigKey)}
		for i, uc := range ucs {
			b, err := uc.MarshalCBOR()
			require.NoError(t, err)
			o.Shards = append(o.Shards, shardOut{Shard: view.Leaves[i].ShardID.String(), UC: hex.EncodeToString(b)})
			require.NoError(t, uc.Verify(f.tb, crypto.SHA256, pvTestPartition, view.Leaves[i].ShardID, topo.ShardConfHashes[view.Leaves[i].ShardID.Key()]))
			o.ConfHashes[view.Leaves[i].ShardID.String()] = hex.EncodeToString(topo.ShardConfHashes[view.Leaves[i].ShardID.Key()])
		}
		b, err := json.MarshalIndent(o, "", "  ")
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(out, "assembly-"+name[len("shards-"):]+".json"), append(b, '\n'), 0o644))
	}
}
